items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Every U6 clause is implemented and tested: bugs not exempt, closed spec_impact_none code, zero-parsed specs fail closed, spec-impact gate on the F5b path, change_type checked against a fork-point-to-working-tree diff incl. untracked, mixed/rename/unknown paths, monorepo and WebUI shapes.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: git present but unable to answer (no trunk ref, git failure, unreadable output, dubious ownership) refuses with change_type_diff_unavailable; not-a-repo warns; a collector crash on present specs reads as found and fails closed.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: git runs with argv lists and no shell; paths are classified, never executed; the run-config override key was dropped after review, so a change cannot widen its own exemption.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 40 new tests tagged FR-01.11/AC03 or AC04 use real git repos for the diff arm; the local-main-at-HEAD test fails against a local-first base choice; existing fixtures updated with the reason code.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: At most five merge-base calls plus rev-list ordering checks, and only on the no-FR branch of an iterate event write.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Three new lib modules under 300 lines; fr_gates.py is at 299; record_event.py shrank 777 to 731; iterate_checks.py unchanged in length.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The event gains spec_impact_reason_code: producers are the record_event CLI and F5b finalize, the consumer is F11 check_spec_impact_recorded; a CLI-to-events.jsonl-to-F11 round-trip probe ran green.
